title: Paite Open Language Data
description:
Open text and speech data for Paite (ISO 639-3: pck; Glottolog: pait1244), an independent Tibeto-Burman language spoken mainly in Churachandpur district, Manipur, India, with communities in Mizoram, Assam and Myanmar. The 2011 Census of India counted 78,725 people whose mother tongue is Paite.

The core of the dataset is everyday Paite-English sentence pairs written by speakers on Paite Daily (paite.lamkalabs.com), each checked by a second speaker before publication, with voice recordings of speakers reading checked lines aloud and a reviewed word list. It also includes the complete Laisiangthou Paite Bible (John Samte, used with permission) aligned verse by verse with the public-domain World English Bible, an English-Paite dictionary and hymn lyrics for research use, native-speaker corrections, ready-to-train JSONL files with fixed train/dev/test splits, and a small everyday-Paite benchmark for AI models.

Rights differ by part: community sentence pairs are CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0 (per line), recordings and corrections are CC BY 4.0, scripts are MIT or Apache 2.0, and third-party texts keep their owners' rights. See LICENSE in the repository.
